This quest is for [[monk]]s and those wishing to take monk as a [[second profession]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = y
| profession = monk
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Meet with [[Paulus the Abbot|Paulus]] inside the [[Catacombs]]. 
* Go with Paulus and use your [[Healing Prayers|healing prayers]] to make sure he survives. 
* Return to Brother Mhenlo for your reward.

===Early benefits===
* Brother Mhenlo will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
** {{skill icon|Bane Signet}}
** {{skill icon|Orison of Healing}}

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
Upon receiving the quest in [[Ashford Abbey]], head through the portal into the Catacombs. Paulus will be waiting just outside the entrance. When you approach him, he will start walking. Simply follow him and make sure he doesn't die in the fights with the [[Raging Cadaver]]s and [[Restless Corpse]]s, and stay close by him at all times so he doesn't stop walking. When you reach the poison water, again, make sure he stays alive. Allow Paulus to collect the [[Unusual Artifact]] and keep following him until you both reach the entrance to Ashford Abbey. Wait for the quest to update then walk through the portal and collect your reward from Mhenlo.

==NPCs==
===Allies===
*{{mo}} 3 [[Paulus the Abbot]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Brother Mhenlo
:''"One of the tasks my messengers have been given is collecting the rare elements in Ascalon for study here at the abbey. My young friend Paulus thinks he has discovered such a [[Unusual Artifact|treasure]] in one of the flooded areas of the catacombs, but he cannot reach it on his own. Paulus, you see, is a smiting Monk and not very adept at healing magic, and the waters in that area of the catacombs are full of disease."'' 

:''"I will grant you a simple healing spell. Meet Paulus inside the catacombs, and he will show you where the trouble is. Return to me when Paulus has successfully retrieved the artifact."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Show me the light.
| decline = I have other plans.
| ask = I'm sure Paulus is waiting for you inside the catacombs. Just head west past the graveyard, and remember to stand near him when you heal.
